source.note: 1975 Topps flagship baseball. TCDB is the checklist and rookie-card authority. The flagship checklist contains 660 cards issued in one series. Physical wax packs contained 10 cards plus gum and no inserts. The 1975 Topps Mini, O-Pee-Chee issue, mail-in Team Checklists, and later Topps Vault File Copies are separate or non-pack issues and are intentionally excluded from this VCS product.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: VCS-normalized pack: 4 cards per pack, 36 packs per box. The physical wax product was 10 cards plus one stick of gum per pack; VCS uses the standing four-card pack rule.
decisions.baseStructure: #1-660, one physical series, modeled as one collector-facing VCS Base ProductSet.
decisions.baseAvailability: All 660 flagship cards have equal VCS pull availability for completion and prestige tracking; no short-print weighting is modeled.
decisions.insertHandling: No pack inserts are modeled because the standard 1975 Topps wax product contained only base cards.
decisions.relatedSetHandling: 1975 Topps Mini and O-Pee-Chee are separate products. Mail-in Team Checklists and later Topps Vault File Copies are not standard wax-pack pulls and are excluded.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Append RC to Player only for card numbers on TCDB's 1975 Topps Rookie Cards index. Generic Rookie subset wording does not independently create an RC label.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains the clean subject plus compact collector abbreviations only. TCDB error annotations and descriptive error text are removed from Player; compact error status may be retained in Variant.
decisions.subsetHandling: Highlights, MVPs, League Leaders, Postseason, Rookie Prospects, team cards, checklists, All-Stars and All-Star Rookies remain inside the single Base ProductSet and are identified through Subset where useful.
decisions.oddsPlacement: There are no non-base ProductSet odds for this product, and no card Variant stores set-wide odds.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until pack imagery, card imagery and pricing are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete flagship checklist #1-660. One series, equal VCS availability. TCDB-recognized true rookie cards receive RC in Player.
